newsitem.title: USA: Standard Register in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Standard Register in marketing pact.

text.p: Standard Register and Lexmark Internatioal Inc entered a joint marketing pact for the companies to market Standard Register's document systems with Lexmark's laser printers.
Within the financial industry, Lexmark and Standard Register will jointly market Standard Register's Secure Printer solution with Lexmark's laser printers.
In health care, Standard Register and Lexmark will market Patient LinkUp with Lexmark's printers, Standard Register said in a statement on Wednesday.
Lexmark will also participate in Standard Register's Document Fraud Prevention Seminars.
